title: PDF Merger
h1: Merge PDF Files Online — Free & Private
seoTitle: Merge PDF Files Online Free — Combine PDFs Privately
description: Combine multiple PDF files into one document and reorder them in seconds. Free PDF merger that runs in your browser — files are never uploaded.
intro: Add two or more PDFs, drag them into the order you want and download a single merged file. Everything happens on your device, so contracts, invoices and scans never leave your computer.
blurb: Combine multiple PDFs into one file in any order — fast, free and fully private.

controls.label: Output file name
controls.help: The merged file is saved with this name. The .pdf ending is added automatically.

howItWorks: Click the upload area or drag two or more PDF files onto it — each file is read locally by your browser.
Drag the files, or use the arrow buttons, to put them in the order you want them in the final document.
Choose a name for the output file and press Merge PDFs — the combined PDF downloads straight to your device.
examples: Combine a signed contract, its appendix and a cover page into one PDF to email.
Join twelve monthly invoice PDFs into a single file for your accountant.
Merge scanned pages from different scanning sessions into one document before archiving.

faq.q: Are my PDF files uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. The merge runs entirely in your browser using a local PDF library, so your files never leave your device and nothing is stored or logged.

faq.q: Is there a limit on file size or number of PDFs?
faq.a: Nothing is uploaded, so there is no server limit. The practical limit is your device's memory — very large files may be slow on phones. You can add up to 50 files at once.
Encrypted or password-protected PDFs can't be merged directly. Remove the password in your PDF viewer first, then add the file again.

faq.q: Will merging change the quality or layout of my pages?
faq.a: No. Pages are copied as they are from each source file, so text, images, fonts and layout are preserved. Interactive form fields and bookmarks from the originals may not carry over.
